verdict.rationale: Retell's pricing page documents usage-based, pay-as-you-go pricing with no contract and a calculator that shows an approximate monthly cost, so a founder can estimate spend before committing. However, no first-party evidence states the actual per-minute rates or offers a per-call cost estimate; the only concrete rate (17¢/min) comes from a community commenter, and the founder notes that costs vary by voice provider. missing for 10: first-party published per-minute rate breakdown (LLM/voice/telephony components), an explicit per-call cost estimate rather than a monthly approximation, independent corroboration of current rates.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing
